units.source_text: 且说葵姬所生小公子夕雾，今年已十二岁，源氏急欲替他举行冠礼，

en.t: Now Yugiri, the young son born to Lady Aoi, was already twelve years old this year, and Genji was eager to hold his coming-of-age ceremony for him.
The place had originally been set as the Nijo residence.

units.source_text: 但夕雾的外祖母太君很想看看这仪式，意欲在自邸举行。

en.t: But Yugiri's maternal grandmother, the grand lady, greatly wished to see the ceremony and wanted it held at her own residence.

units.source_text: 太君这要求自然合乎情理，不可违背而使她伤心。

en.t: The grand lady's request was naturally reasonable, and it would not do to refuse her and make her sad.

units.source_text: 于是决定就在故太政大臣邸内举行。

en.t: So it was decided that the ceremony would be held at the residence of the late Chancellor.

units.source_text: 右大将以及诸母舅，都是公卿贵官，朝廷所特别信任之人。

en.t: The Right General and Yugiri's maternal uncles were all high-ranking court nobles and officials, men especially trusted by the court.

units.source_text: 他们就当了主人，各有隆重优厚的贺仪。

en.t: They took the role of hosts, each offering splendid and generous congratulations.

units.source_text: 此外世间一般臣民，也都重视这仪式，因此举办得异常隆重。

en.t: In addition, people throughout society, from officials to common subjects, also regarded the ceremony as important, so it was carried out with extraordinary grandeur.

units.source_text: 源氏本想封夕雾四位官爵，世人也都如此预料。

en.t: Genji had originally intended to grant Yugiri the rank and office of the Fourth Rank, and people generally expected this as well.
But Yugiri was still very young.

units.source_text: 源氏虽然独揽大权，世事可以任所欲为，但若教儿子一跃便登四位，反而变成权臣故技，

en.t: Although Genji held power entirely in his own hands and could do as he pleased in worldly affairs, if he let his son leap straight to the Fourth Rank, it would look instead like the old tactic of an overmighty minister.

units.source_text: 因此打消此议，决定封他六位，赐穿淡绿官袍，并仍特许上殿。

en.t: He therefore abandoned that plan, decided to confer the Sixth Rank on him, granted him the pale green official robe, and still gave him special permission to attend court.
